name: CIS Microsoft Windows Server — Level 1
description: Center for Internet Security Microsoft Windows Server Benchmark — Level 1 (essential security hygiene for domain-joined and stand-alone Windows servers).

controls.name: Minimum password length
controls.desc: Enforce a minimum password length policy. Short passwords are trivially brute-forced.

controls.name: Password complexity required
controls.desc: Require complex passwords (mix of upper/lower case, digits, symbols) to resist dictionary attacks.

controls.name: Account lockout after failed attempts
controls.desc: Lock accounts after repeated failed login attempts to slow brute-force attacks.

controls.name: Guest account disabled
controls.desc: The built-in Guest account allows anonymous access and must be disabled.

controls.name: SMB signing required
controls.desc: SMB packet signing prevents man-in-the-middle attacks on file-sharing traffic.

controls.name: User Account Control enabled
controls.desc: UAC prompts before privileged operations, mitigating privilege-escalation malware.

controls.name: Windows Defender Firewall active
controls.desc: Host-level packet filtering must be enabled on Domain, Private, and Public profiles.

controls.name: Audit Logon and Account Logon events
controls.desc: Successful and failed logons must be logged for forensics and breach detection.

controls.name: SMBv1 client and server disabled
controls.desc: SMBv1 has known wormable vulnerabilities (EternalBlue, WannaCry, NotPetya). Must be disabled.

controls.name: WDigest authentication disabled
controls.desc: WDigest stores plaintext credentials in LSASS memory and must be disabled to prevent credential theft via Mimikatz-style tools.

controls.name: Disable automatic interactive sign-in
controls.desc: Auto-login bypasses authentication and must be disabled on multi-user systems and servers.

controls.name: LLMNR disabled
controls.desc: Link-Local Multicast Name Resolution is exploited by Responder-style poisoning attacks to capture credential hashes.

controls.name: BitLocker drive encryption enabled
controls.desc: Full-disk encryption protects data at rest if the device is stolen, lost, or decommissioned without proper wiping.

controls.name: RDP Network Level Authentication
controls.desc: NLA requires authentication before establishing a Remote Desktop session, blocking pre-auth exploits and resource exhaustion attacks.

controls.name: Microsoft Defender real-time protection
controls.desc: Real-time anti-malware scanning is essential against active threats; signatures must be kept current.

controls.name: PowerShell script-block logging
controls.desc: Logs full content of PowerShell scripts for forensic analysis of attacks using PowerShell as living-off-the-land tooling.

controls.name: Security updates applied
controls.desc: Windows Update must keep the system current with security patches; no patches pending reboot for extended periods.

controls.name: Strong cryptographic protocols (SChannel)
controls.desc: Disable weak TLS/SSL protocols and ciphers at the SChannel level so all Windows components benefit.
